quiesce.method: Set MinecraftServer desiredState=Stopped and wait for Pod termination before snapshot

retention: Keep the VolumeSnapshot and VolumeSnapshotContent through T7 acceptance; deletion removes the RustFS object.
limitations: This is an initial baseline only; it has not been restored or application-validated.
Felis backup-now excludes the system Login server; LOOHP/Limbo has no RCON.
Recurring protection needs an orchestrator that gracefully stops Login around every LINSTOR snapshot.
